intro: An administrative assistant resume that shows the office ran better because of you: calendars, events, systems and savings, with the scale of the support.
tips: Say who you supported and how many: executives, teams, offices.
Show systems you set up or improved, and the time or money saved.

basics.name: Emma Thompson
basics.label: Executive Assistant
basics.summary: Executive assistant with eight years supporting senior leaders in professional services. Runs complex calendars across time zones, plans events for up to 300 guests, and set up the office's travel and expenses process.

work.name: Harcourt & Lane LLP
work.position: Executive Assistant to the Managing Partner
highlights: Manage the managing partner's calendar, travel and correspondence across three time zones.
Organised the firm's annual conference for 300 guests, within a £120k budget.
Set up a new travel and expenses process in SAP Concur; reimbursement time fell from 3 weeks to 5 days.

work.name: Brightwell Consulting
highlights: Supported a team of 12 consultants with diaries, travel and client meetings.
Digitised the filing system, freeing a room for meetings.
